prompts.mirror: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE asset design sheet for a small handheld oval mirror for this exact pink round Bubu character. Four clean isolated prop views: front, side, three-quarter, back; plus one small usage vignette with the unchanged pink character beside it. Mirror has muted mint rounded oval frame, short sturdy handle, plain silver reflective face and cream back. Scale mirror total height around one third character height, width one fifth. The reference character is round pink with two tiny pointed ears, tiny two short arms and two feet, large black eyes and tiny O mouth; omit its halo. Do not redesign character, do not add fingers, hands or limbs. Mirror sits beside original short hand, no exaggerated arms. White studio background, no words. This is a concept reference for a later true 3D mesh.
prompts.tissue: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE tissue accessory design sheet, four isolated front/side/45/back views plus one use-scale vignette beside exact reference pink Bubu (omit halo). A small cream rounded tissue box with muted mint base, oval dispensing slit and a single soft white folded tissue rising. Box width quarter of character body, on floor beside character. True soft 3D toy style, clean white studio. Keep character round, original tiny short arms two only, two feet, two pointy ears, unchanged big eyes and tiny mouth. No hands holding box, no extra limbs, no words. Tissue box is scene prop; no body rescaling.
prompts.cushion: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE round floor cushion asset design sheet: four isolated orthographic front/side/45/back views and one small character scale vignette. Beside unchanged Bubu on same floor, not under feet in this reference. Bubu exact reference identity, omit halo, keep tiny two arms and two feet unchanged; no additional limbs. White studio, soft 3D toy aesthetic, no text. Distinct from rectangular sleeping pillow.
